style: Hand-drawn cartoon illustration with flat colours and clean black ink outlines, warm cream paper background, soft shadows, friendly and funny. The top third of the picture is plain empty cream paper. No text, no letters, no numbers anywhere.

long.title: Funny True History Stories
long.description: Every full story from Tea Break with Manoj: funny true history, explained in the time it takes to drink your tea. Every word is true, with the sources in each video's description. A new story every Saturday.

shorts.title: Funny History Shorts
shorts.description: The funniest moments from the full stories, in under a minute. Every word is true. Watch the whole story in the playlist Funny True History Stories.

wars.title: Weird Wars in History
wars.description: Real wars that sound made up: an army against 20,000 emus, two countries and one pig, and more. The true stories, with sources, from Tea Break with Manoj.

animals.title: Animals That Made History
animals.description: Animals that made real history: an army beaten by emus, two countries nearly at war over a pig, a chicken that lived without its head, a bear that joined the army. Funny true stories, with sources, from Tea Break with Manoj.

crazes.title: History's Craziest Hoaxes and Crazes
crazes.description: The hoaxes and crazes people fell for: bat-men on the Moon, flower bulbs that cost ten years' wages, a town that could not stop dancing, spaghetti growing on trees. Funny true stories, with sources, from Tea Break with Manoj.

strange.title: Strange But True History
strange.description: Moments from history that sound made up: meat falling from a clear sky, a dead whale blown up with dynamite, a river so smelly that Parliament thought about moving out. Funny true stories, with sources, from Tea Break with Manoj.
